stem: The numbers of barrels of oil, in millions, extracted per day in two oil fields $A$ and $B$ are modelled by the independent random variables $X$ and $Y$ respectively, where $X \sim \text{N}(3.2, 0.4^2)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(4.3, 0.6^2)$. The income generated by the oil from the two fields is \$90 per barrel for $A$ and \$95 per barrel for $B$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of the daily income, in millions of dollars, generated by field $A$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total income produced by the two fields in a day is at least \$670 million.
